summary: Lead your squad through Hell’s circles in a thrilling turn-based strategy!
description: Chaos reigns in Hell. Lead a fearless squad of heroes through five underworld realms. Survive epic turn-based battles against hordes of evil on your way to the Devil’s lair! Guards II is a turn-based tactical game that breaks the usual strategy rules. To make a move, you swap two heroes. A simple action opens endless room for tactical combinations and demands clever planning. 🎮 Unique Mechanics Command a team of four heroes: three fight on the front line, while the fourth recovers strength in the back. Each turn is built around position swapping — when a hero moves from the backline to the front, they unleash a powerful ultimate that can change the course of battle. Every hero also has two unique stances, unlocking even more strategies. All units deal one of four damage types — Physical, Fire, Magic, or Death — and every enemy has its own strengths and vulnerabilities. Mastering these interactions is the key to victory. Game Features: 🔥 Original turn-based combat system 🔥 Eight heroes with unique abilities and battle styles 🔥 A shared skill system with tons of variations 🔥 Deep upgrade trees for each hero 🔥 Five distinct underworld realms with 80 levels total 🔥 Hell Mode with 80 extra missions, tougher enemies, and new mechanics 🔥 Special in-game challenges to test your tactical skills Time to descend into the Underworld! Face fiery battles, tough decisions, and the thrill of victory like never before. In Guards II, there is no luck — only your strategy and the strength of your team. Can you conquer all the realms of Hell, defeat the legions of darkness, and challenge the Devil himself? _______________________________________________________ Follow us for more strategy games: X: @Herocraft_rus YouTube: youtube.com/herocraft Facebook: facebook.com/herocraft.games
